purpose: Pinned execution/comparison reference for the SynthRAN rework. This is separate from historical derivation provenance in SOURCE.json.

mapping.status: direct for physical R2Lab; rfsim remains locally derived

mapping.reference: qhats/qfits inventory groups plus fiveg profile UEs
mapping.rule: resource selection, subscriber identity and attachment are separate concerns
effective SynthRAN profile adapters must be validated per backend
SynthRAN renders the selected inventory rather than relying on a fork-only normalizer

delegation_policy.reason: Pure upstream deploy_r2lab.yml owns cleanup/RRU/UE preparation and deploy.yml invokes POS for every SOP node. The upstream POS role unconditionally frees/allocates resources before its no_boot-guarded image/reset work, so invoking those full playbooks would violate SynthRAN's authoritative reservation/POS boundary.

external_resource_authority.reason: Issue #52 establishes SynthRAN as the sole SLICES/POS/R2Lab acquisition and POS-preparation authority. Pure upstream has no complete suppression surface for its POS allocation steps, so full upstream resource/deploy playbooks are not callable after SynthRAN resource preparation.

reference_candidate: explicitly reviewed downstream host/Kubernetes/core/RAN task files after SynthRAN resource preparation
selected-resource teardown only where a dependent issue proves the exact boundary
synthran: translation and fail-closed validation before delegation
POS allocation, image, boot-parameter, reset and post-reset readiness
R2Lab lease acquisition/extension/require-existing verification and evidence
physical UE acceptance beyond upstream provisioning

resolved_decisions.decision: The execution/comparison authority is the original sopnode/5g_ansible repository at an immutable upstream commit. Fork-only machine-interface behavior is not part of the reference contract.
SynthRAN is the sole resource-acquisition and POS-preparation authority; pure upstream full deploy/R2Lab playbooks are not invoked across that boundary.

known_gaps.detail: Pure sopnode/5g_ansible does not provide the fork-added bin/fiveg or tools/fiveg_machine.py API. SynthRAN validates the upstream source/task contract directly instead.

Pure upstream roles/pos/tasks/main.yml frees and allocates unconditionally; no_boot suppresses later image/reset work only. Full upstream deploy.yml therefore cannot run after SynthRAN resource preparation.
Pure upstream roles load repository-named fiveg_profile files; SynthRAN effective profile adapters remain backend-specific and must be validated from rendered configuration.
Pure upstream test-ue-connect.yml is separate from deployment and ignores individual connection errors; SynthRAN requires explicit selected-UE lifecycle ownership and fail-closed evidence.
SynthRAN N320-specific OAI behavior is reviewed separately from the generic upstream lifecycle.

Pure upstream deploy_with_check.yml differs from the former fork-derived pin. SynthRAN's post-deploy RF/PHY health attestation remains authoritative for acceptance; fresh physical validation is required.
Completion of delegated upstream provisioning is not equivalent to SynthRAN experiment eligibility; fresh acceptance evidence remains required.
